title.en: PaLM-E Figure 1: embodied multimodal model overview
title.zh: PaLM-E Figure 1：具身多模态模型总览

notes.en: Paper-rendered Figure 1 combines mobile manipulation, task-and-motion planning, tabletop manipulation, visual question answering and the multimodal-token path into PaLM. It is the most representative commonly used overview screenshot, but the existing original local explainer remains the single selected explanatory image; the HTML rendering states no separate redistribution license.
notes.zh: 论文 HTML 渲染的 Figure 1 汇集移动操作、任务与运动规划、桌面操作、视觉问答，以及多模态 token 进入 PaLM 的路径，是最具代表性的常用总览截图。页面仍只选用现有本地原创解释图；HTML 渲染未为该图单独声明再分发许可。
